title: Curating this challenge like I’m curating a syllabus. Welcome to Musi...
transcript: Welcome to week two of the 100 Musical Challenge for 2026. Every week, I'm picking two cast albums to listen to. One from Broadway in the West End, the other from literally anywhere else. And this week I have an interesting companion pairing. Obviously, for Broadway, we're listening to the 2025 Ragtime Revival cast album that just dropped on Friday. But I'd like to pair this with American Morning, which is a concept album of a musical that's been in development. This is originally part of the 2015 NAMT Festival and has done some workshop production since then, but it has not ever had a full fledged stage production yet. Similar to parts of Ragtime, American Morning is a story about immigrants living in New York City only. Specifically about two Asian immigrant cab drivers and how their lives intertwine with each other. For extra credit, I will, of course, of course, recommend that you listen to the original Broadway cast album of ragtime if you haven't before, especially if this is your first introduction to the show. But I also wanna highly encourage you, in listening to these two pieces, to listen to the concept album of ragtime, because of how much ragtime has changed from that initial concept album, and considering that American Morning is also a concept album of a show that has not been fully staged yet. And so, even though American Morning isn't a perfect cast album by any means, it is very much a work in Progress similar to where ragtime was when they recorded that first songs from ragtime album. And so what I always like to do when I'm listening to concept albums is hear what is working in the story, what is working in the score, what is grabbing me? And what about it do I want to see fully staged? And what about it do I feel like still needs a little bit of work? Especially if you're ever thinking about being a creative and the arts. I always like to approach works in progress like a concept album with that mentality of, where is this going and what could this be? And as a reminder, we are talking about all of the cast albums in depth on the discord, so if you wanna join that, you're more than welcome to. And if you wanna join the challenge, it's. It's very easy to join. Right now. We're only four shows in, so join us. Join us. Let's do 100 cast albums this year.
classificationReason: Week 2 of the '100 Musical Challenge' series recommending the 2025 Ragtime revival cast album alongside a concept album. While the Broadway production is identified, the content is about listening to the cast recording, not reviewing the live stage show — no first-hand production opinion is expressed.
